modules.name: examples/options/bs

defs.doc:
The implied volatility of one quote, or NaN when the price is outside the
no-arbitrage bounds. Newton steps on log(otm(s)) - log(target) in
s = sigma sqrt(T), kept inside a bracket [lo, hi] that every evaluation
shrinks; a step that leaves it is replaced by bisection (or doubling while
hi is unknown). Stops when a step is below 4e-16 of s.
defs.intent: The implied volatility of one quote, or NaN when the price is outside the no-arbitrage bounds. Newton steps on log(otm(s)) - log(target) in s = sigma sqrt(T), kept inside a bracket [lo, hi] that every evaluation shrinks; a step that leaves it is replaced by bisection (or doubling while hi is unknown). Stops when a step is below 4e-16 of s.

defs.doc:
The undiscounted out-of-the-money option on forward F with s = sigma sqrt(T):
a call when K >= F, a put otherwise. Each term is a tail probability, so
nothing large is subtracted to make something small.

The standard normal CDF, Cody's algorithm: three rational approximations,
|x| < 0.674, |x| < sqrt(32), and the asymptotic tail.
defs.intent: The standard normal CDF, Cody's algorithm: three rational approximations, |x| < 0.674, |x| < sqrt(32), and the asymptotic tail.

defs.doc:
exp(-y^2 / 2) with y split as ys + (y - ys), ys a multiple of 1/16, so the
exponent of the larger part is exact (Cody's device against cancellation)
